name: Garden Gnome
description: An at-a-glance helper for home gardeners. Set a location, pick your soil, tick the plants you grow, and Garden Gnome's server half fetches local weather (Open-Meteo, keyless) at most every 15 minutes — past 5 days plus the next 24 hours — and shows three color-coded dots on a +/- spectrum next to each plant for water, temperature and sunlight, with badges for freeze, heat, drought and waterlogging. Editors of the space set the garden up; members read the board; anyone else the frame is published to gets the same read-only board with the town withheld. Each Garden Gnome keeps its garden as its own session state in the space, so two in one space can watch two gardens.
